fact: In a keynote address reported on 23 October 2025 the Minister of Police Affairs said the upgraded Nigeria Police Crime and Incident Database Centre (NPCIDB) has enabled police to document criminals' data, with biometrics, at Divisional Police Stations across the country and forward it digitally to the NPCIDB, housed in the National Criminal Data Fusion Centre; he named both among initiatives the Federal Government, through the Ministry, has started realising, and gave no count of stations.
title: Gaidam Reaffirms Government Commitment to Data-Driven Strategies for Policing
